outcome_evidence: In base_image, frames 0–57 show the gripper opening and approaching the cups beside the cardboard box. failure_annotations.explanation: After approaching the cups, the open gripper remains essentially stationary beside and above them throughout base_image frames 58–145. failure_annotations.severity_evidence: The stall prevents task progress, but base_image frames 58–145 show no displaced cups, damage, or other harmful consequences.
